      title: Owner fields

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        errors:
          title: Errors
          description: Names of the request fields that failed validation.
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          example:
            - city
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - errors
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized
            by removing every non-digit character and must yield exactly 10 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

          required:
            - pets

      properties:

## Summary

Added an optional `email` field to owners: when present it must be syntactically valid, is stored/returned lower-cased, and an invalid value is rejected with 400.

**Changes made:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `email` property (`type: string`, `format: email`, `maxLength: 255`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Since the generator has `performBeanValidation`, this emits a `@Email` constraint on the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`, and the field flows into `OwnerDto` for responses.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — Added the `email` column (`@Column(name = "email")`) with getter/setter.

3. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — In `addOwner` (and `updateOwner` for consistency), when `email` is present it's trimmed, lower-cased, and validated against a syntactic pattern (`^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$`); invalid → `400 Bad Request`. The normalized value is what gets persisted. MapStruct maps `email` between DTO and entity automatically.

4. **Schema DDL** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`) — Added the `email` column to the `owners` table. This is required because the hsqldb profile used by tests runs with `ddl-auto=none`.

5. **Seed data** (`db/hsqldb/data.sql`, `db/mysql/data.sql`) — These used positional `INSERT INTO owners VALUES (...)`, which broke with the new column, so I appended a `NULL` email to each seed owner. (h2/postgres already used explicit column lists and needed no change.)

**Test results:** The three new acceptance tests (`coreLowercasesEmail`, `errorRejectsInvalidEmail`, `functionalityAcceptsMissingEmail`) and the full suite pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`.

Note: validation is enforced both by the generated `@Email` bean-validation constraint and the controller's explicit check; the controller additionally performs the lower-casing normalization that bean validation alone doesn't do.
